title: Search systematically for target objects across multiple storage locations
description: Use when a required object is not found in the first few locations checked.
content: When searching for an object like a mug, do not give up after checking a few cabinets; continue checking other cabinets, countertops, and appliances. Objects may be placed on open surfaces such as countertops rather than inside closed storage, so examine both open and closed locations.

title: Locate target objects by searching storage furniture
description: Use this when the required object is not visible on open surfaces and may be inside closed storage.
content: When searching for a small object like a pencil, check closed storage furniture such as drawers by opening them, and also inspect the tops of nearby furniture, since objects can be placed either inside or on top of storage units.

title: Use a fridge to cool items before placing them in appliances
description: Use when a task requires cooling an object before placing it in another appliance.
content: To cool an object, first locate and take the object, then go to a fridge and use the "cool [object] with [fridge]" action. The fridge does not need to contain the object beforehand; the cooling action can be performed while holding the object.

title: Verify destination surface before placing objects
description: Use this when placing an object onto a target surface to confirm the correct location.
content: Before moving an object to a destination, go to the destination and examine what is already there to ensure it is the correct surface, then place the object onto it.
